hard_rules: wow-service is the only framework dependency
each valid command invokes exactly one service operation
the app contains no build signing distribution download verification installer migration helper or rollback semantics
local identity verification and installation validation commands perform no network access
update check is explicit and never downloads or installs
update plan apply rollback and reconcile remain separate commands and effects
the app never selects latest newest previous highest version tag filename directory or same name targets
the app never overwrites its running executable executes bundle scripts runs shell commands edits store or configuration or chooses a helper
the Windows replacement helper is selected launched and validated only by the installation owner under the exact plan
public inputs contain no signing distribution provider or helper credentials private endpoints arbitrary URLs headers commands or environment blocks
OutcomeUnknown is unsafe to retry and update reconcile never redispatches
JSON output is exact service bytes plus one LF and broken pipe never repeats service
baseline performs no startup background update check download install telemetry crash upload or remote configuration
missing service installer helper platform or checksum evidence remains unimplemented and unadvertised

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: implemented and frozen E7-B service update installation rollback and reconciliation contracts
exact Windows helper handoff input output exit path and process lifecycle profiles
canonical command request result text artifact and error vectors
network absence and explicit update-policy tests
Windows console PowerShell cmd path lock antivirus daemon LSP MCP drain and crash recovery reports
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
